## Description

The description the MCP server sends to the model, word for word. Its rules apply to every call.

> Save a new Coach skill for the user: reusable instructions for a job. Only call this when they ask. title names it, description says when to use it, and instructions hold the steps, format, and tone. The Coach won't use it on its own until they turn that on.

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `description` | `string` | Yes | Min length 1. Max length 200. |
| `instructions` | `string` | Yes | Min length 1. Max length 8000. |
| `title` | `string` | Yes | Min length 1. Max length 60. |

## Example call

The smallest valid request: required arguments only, with placeholder values.

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "create_skill",
    "arguments": {
      "title": "…",
      "description": "…",
      "instructions": "…"
    }
  }
}
```
